verdicts.reason: A: the logo is blown up into a huge disc that competes with the headline, the dark header bar has turned into a stray block in the top-right corner, and the CTA sits above the headline and partly over the edge of that block, so the reading order is broken. 'Ships late June' is now as big as the body copy and the legal line is unreadably small. B has the same oversized logo and stray dark block, but it is worse: the CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill at the bottom next to the legal line, so the action is buried. A large empty area separates that pill from the text cluster, and there is an underline artifact on 'seaside k'. A at least keeps the CTA prominent.
